blocks.text: 1964 mein M. Gell-Mann aur George Zweig ne tajweez kiya ke koi bhi hadron, proton aur neutron bhi, waqai bunyadi nahi balke teen zyada bunyadi cheezon, quarks ya quark flavours, ke mel se bana hai. Quarks leptons ki tarah waqai bunyadi zarre mane jate hain. Shuru mein tajweez kiye teen quarks up, down aur strange (u, d aur s) the. Ab hum chhe quarks jaante hain, jaise chhe leptons hain, fitrat mein farzi tanasub (symmetry) ki bunyad par; baqi teen charm, bottom aur top (c, b, t) kehlate hain. Tamam quarks ka spin aur electric charge hai, jo electron par pehle sab se chhota samjhe jane wale charge e ka kasr (fraction) hai. Quarks kabhi akele nazar nahi aate.

Tamam hadrons quarks ke mel (aur unhein jore rakhne wale gluons) se bane mane jate hain, aur un ki khusoosiyat un ke quark content se bayan hoti hain. Mesons quark-antiquark jore hain: maslan pi+ meson up quark aur anti-down quark hai, aur pi0 u aur anti-u se ban sakta hai. Har baryon teen quarks ka hai. Proton ki quark banawat uud hai, to us ka charge quantum number q(uud) = 2/3 + 2/3 + (-1/3) = +1 (print yahan q(udd) likhta hai). Neutron ki banawat udd hai, aur q(udd) = 2/3 + (-1/3) + (-1/3) = 0. pi+ meson ke liye up quark +2/3 aur anti-down quark +1/3 hai, jo mil kar charge quantum number +1 dete hain.

blocks.alt: Do tikiyan (discs): surkh disc par Proton likha hai jis mein teen chhote quarks u, d aur u hain, aur hari disc par Neutron jis mein teen chhote quarks u, d aur d hain.
blocks.caption: Proton (uud) aur neutron (udd) ki quark banawat (kitab mein Table 12.4 ke saath bane be-unwan khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har quark ka charge jor kar dekhein: up quark (u) +2/3 aur down quark (d) -1/3. Proton = u + u + d = 2/3 + 2/3 - 1/3 = +1. Neutron = u + d + d = 2/3 - 1/3 - 1/3 = 0. Kitab mein proton ke hisaab ke saath q(udd) chhapa hai; sahi q(uud) hai, jaisa upar ke jor se zahir hai. Kitab ki tasveer mein quarks ke harf (letters) bohat chhote chhape hain, is liye yahan text ke mutabiq proton mein u, u, d aur neutron mein u, d, d likhe gaye hain.

Quark theory pesh hone ke kuch hi arse baad tajweez kiya gaya ke quarks ki ek aur khasiyat hai jise colour, ya colour charge (electric charge ke mushabeh), kehte hain. Har flavour ka quark teen rangon mein se ek, aam taur par surkh, sabz aur neela, rakh sakta hai; colour aur flavour ke naam hamare hawas se mutalliq nahi. Antiquarks antired, antigreen aur antiblue hote hain. Baryons teen quarks se, har rang ka ek, bante hain (neela + surkh + sabz = safed, Fig. 12.7a), aur antibaryons antiblue + antired + antigreen se (Fig. 12.7b); mesons kisi rang aur us ke anticolour wale quark-antiquark jore hain. Yun baryons aur mesons dono be-rang, ya safed, hain. Quarks ke darmiyan strong force colour force kehlati hai, aur strong force ka nazariya quantum chromodynamics, ya QCD, kehlata hai, yeh dikhane ke liye ke force colour charges (electric charges nahi) ke darmiyan lagti hai. Do hadrons ke darmiyan strong force un ko banane wale quarks ke darmiyan force mani jati hai.

blocks.alt: Teen bare daire. (a) Proton aur Neutron: har ek mein teen quarks, ek neela, ek surkh aur ek hara; proton mein u, d aur u, neutron mein u, d aur d. (b) Antiproton: teen antiquarks, anti-u peela (antiblue), anti-u magenta (antigreen) aur anti-d cyan (antired).
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: (a) Be-rang (colourless) baryons: neela + surkh + hara = safed; (b) Be-rang antibaryon: antiblue + antired + antigreen = safed (kitab ki Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har baryon mein teen quarks hain aur har quark ka 'colour' alag hai: ek surkh, ek hara, ek neela. Teeno mil kar 'safed' yaani be-rang (colourless) ho jate hain, jaise roshni ke teen bunyadi rang mil kar safed roshni banate hain. Antiproton ke antiquarks ulte rang (anticolours) rakhte hain: antiblue ko peela, antigreen ko magenta aur antired ko cyan dikhaya gaya hai; yeh teeno bhi mil kar safed hain. Yaad rahe ke yeh 'colour' asal rang nahi, sirf quarks ki ek khasiyat (colour charge) ka naam hai.
Quarks ki zabaan mein beta decay

Jab nucleus mein neutron proton aur electron (beta particle) mein badalta hai to antineutrino bhi banta hai: n -> p + e- + nu-bar. udd banawat wala neutron ek down quark ko up quark mein badal kar uud banawat wala proton ban sakta hai, to bunyadi decay amal d -> u + e- + nu-bar hai. Neutron sirf nucleus ke andar paidar hai; azaad neutrons decay ho jate hain, kitab un ki half-life 900 s batati hai (Do You Know). Jaise maadde ki bunyadi fitrat ki samajh gehri hoti hai, quark model na sirf zarron ki banawat batata hai balke un ke taamulat ki samajh bhi deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Quark banawat ke lihaz se protons aur neutrons bayan kijiye (comprehensive question 12.6). Proton aur neutron ek doosre mein kaise badalte hain (short question 12.10)?
blocks.explanation: Proton: do up quarks aur ek down quark, uud, charge 2/3 + 2/3 - 1/3 = +1. Neutron: ek up aur do down quarks, udd, charge 2/3 - 1/3 - 1/3 = 0; har ek mein teen quarks teen rang rakhte hain, to zarra be-rang hai. Beta-minus decay mein down quark up quark banta hai (d -> u + e- + nu-bar), jis se neutron proton banta hai; beta-plus decay mein up quark down quark banta hai (u -> d + e+ + nu), jis se proton neutron banta hai.

items: Gell-Mann aur Zweig (1964): hadrons quarks se bane, jo kabhi akele nahi milte. Chhe flavours: u (+2/3), d (-1/3), c (+2/3), s (-1/3), t (+2/3), b (-1/3), antiquarks ulat charge ke saath (Table 12.4).
Baryons: teen quarks (proton uud, +1; neutron udd, 0). Mesons: quark + antiquark (pi+ = u + anti-d). Rang: surkh, sabz, neela; hadrons be-rang; colour force, QCD. Beta decay: d -> u + e- + nu-bar.
